checkpoints.description: [1/2] Levels cycle: seal the campaign on clear so wave 4 cannot spawn or attack during the victory banner, with a banner pair and campaign drill

impact_assessment.why: Campaign clear is recorded at wave-4 entry, but the sim had already built wave 4 and kept spawning enemies during the four-second banner; the player could be attacked in a won run.
impact_assessment.benefits: The victory beat is safe and the arena is empty; wave construction stops permanently after the campaign win.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: sim victory state + game clear hook; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: wave/campaign flow only, no level geometry.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first seal test, a three-second banner pair, campaign drill telemetry and the full suite including the fairness replay.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Campaign seal proven: 225 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 18368 px banner pair, wave-4 enemies 4->0, same hp/banner; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-68-campaign-seal' completed successfully.
[1/2] UI cycle: keep a compact CAMPAIGN COMPLETE line visible after the victory banner, with a post-banner pair and campaign-drill parity

impact_assessment.why: After cycle 68 seals the campaign, the four-second banner disappears into an empty wave-4 arena with no indication the run is complete.
impact_assessment.benefits: The won state stays readable after the banner without changing enemy, wave or save state.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: HUD draw only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, wave, camera or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first post-banner/banner tests, a 300-frame capture pair, campaign-drill hash parity and the full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Completion line proven: 228 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 988 px post-banner pair, same campaign hash 236ec766, no enemies; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-69-campaign-complete' completed successfully.
[1/2] Graphics cycle: render dropped ammo caches with a shared glowing cube pool, a staged cache pair and a cache-bearing played run

impact_assessment.why: The sim drops ammo caches for 8 seconds, but no scene node represents them, so the pickup is invisible and impossible to seek intentionally.
impact_assessment.benefits: A visible amber cache cube marks the drop, using a shared mesh/material pool and no sim or collider change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: scene presentation only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no cache lifetime, pickup, reward RNG or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first visibility/pool tests, a staged drop pair at 960x540, a campaign/cache drill and the frame-budget test.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Cache visibility proven: 231 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 5406 px cache pair, same campaign hash 54bdc60c, 2 drops/1 collect; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-70-cache-visual' completed successfully.
[1/2] Audio cycle: map the existing cache_drop event to a distinct chime and AMMO CACHE DROP caption, with a forced-drop pair and a kited cache run

impact_assessment.why: The sim emits cache_drop when a kill leaves an ammo cache, but only collection is mapped; the drop is silent even though the cache is now visible.
impact_assessment.benefits: A short distinct chime and caption announce the drop at the kill, making the new cache visual findable without changing lifetime or rewards.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: event/audio/caption only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, cache, reward RNG or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first forced-drop tests, a captioned pair at 960x540, cache-clip counts in kite 3000 and a WAV/spectrogram probe.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Cache-drop cue proven: 234 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 5388 px pair, 2 natural drop clips 437->439, same campaign hash 54bdc60c; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-71-cache-drop-cue' completed successfully.
[1/2] Progression cycle: report corrupt-profile recovery/reset in the debrief, with corrupt-profile tests, a reset pair and a profile_corrupt death drill

impact_assessment.why: ProfileStore quarantines a corrupt file and silently falls back to .bak or defaults; the game never tells the player that progress was restored or reset.
impact_assessment.benefits: A red PROFILE RESET (or amber PROFILE RECOVERED) line makes silent data loss/recovery visible without changing quarantine or save policy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: load diagnostics + debrief draw; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: profile schema, quarantine and atomic save unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first flag/HUD tests, a corrupt-profile capture pair, a profile_corrupt drill and the full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Profile recovery surfaced: 238 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 13136 px reset pair, same death hash f8cd9e28, reset flag true; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-72-profile-reset' completed successfully.
[1/2] Combat-feel cycle: add a deterministic speed-driven viewmodel bob, with a moving-frame pair and strafe-drill parity

impact_assessment.why: The first-person gun stays rigidly locked to the camera while walking or sprinting; only recoil and reload move it, so movement feels floaty.
impact_assessment.benefits: A small DATA-driven figure-eight sway follows horizontal speed and returns to rest, using the existing gun nodes and no new draws.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: viewmodel presentation only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, movement, aim or save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first speed/rest tests, a moving capture pair at 960x540, strafe-drill hash parity and the full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Movement bob proven: 241 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 3043 px gun-only pair, same strafe hash 14a48660, body x 0.210->0.232; checklists: passed
Task 'shooter-cycle-73-viewmodel-bob' completed successfully.
[1/2] Enemies cycle: close the brute 2.5-3.0 m dead zone so it advances into attack range, with a stall test, idle pair and brute drill

impact_assessment.why: A brute moves only when farther than 3.0 m but slams only within 2.5 m; at 2.7 m from a stationary player it stands still forever.
impact_assessment.benefits: Brutes close the final half metre and slam, matching their intended melee pressure without changing damage, range or cooldowns.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: brute movement branch only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: deterministic movement, no new damage tuning.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first stall test, a fixed-time idle capture pair, a brute-gap drill and the fairness/campaign suites.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Brute gap closed: 242 tests, determinism 1800 ok, aikit 4/4, 101970 px slam pair, brute_gap hp 100->80, brute_slam fires; checklists: passed
